Terms of use

Draft dated November 13, 2026.

By using SkipperCast you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use it.

1. A planning aid, not for navigation or safety decisions

SkipperCast helps you plan a fishing trip. It is not a navigation aid or a nautical chart. Do not use it to navigate, avoid collisions, anchor, or decide whether a harbor entrance, bar or passage is safe. Maps, depths, habitat outlines, bearings and exported waypoints can be incomplete, out of date, offset or wrong. Use current official charts, your instruments and your own judgment.

2. Forecasts and scores are estimates

Wind, waves, currents, temperatures, comfort scores, habitat grades and alerts come from computer models and from automated processing of other organizations’ data. They can be late, missing or wrong, and real conditions can differ sharply. A good score or a “within your limits” alert does not mean it is safe or that fish are there. Check the official National Weather Service marine forecast and current conditions before and during every trip.

3. Rules may be out of date; the official regulations govern

Fishing rules, seasons, limits, depth rules, protected areas and closures change, sometimes with little notice. SkipperCast shows rules it has summarized and links to the official sources, but it is not legal advice and it is not an official source. Before you fish, check the current rules with the California Department of Fish and Wildlife and, for federal waters, NOAA Fisheries. You are responsible for following the law.

4. You decide, and you take the risks

Boating and fishing are dangerous. You alone decide whether, when and where to go, and you are responsible for your boat, crew and passengers.

5. No warranty

SkipperCast is provided “as is” and “as available”, without any warranty, to the extent the law allows.

6. Limit of liability

To the extent the law allows, the operator is not liable for injury, loss of property, fines, lost catch or other loss from using or relying on SkipperCast.

7. Accounts

Accounts use passkeys. You are responsible for the devices that hold your passkeys. You can delete your account at any time, as described in the privacy notice. SkipperCast has no paid plans today.

8. Fair use

Do not try to reach other people’s data, overload the service, get around rate limits or security controls, or use it for anything unlawful. We may block access that harms the service.

9. Data from others

Maps, forecasts and rules come from public agencies and other providers, each under its own terms. See Sources & methods and Licences & attributions.

10. Changes and contact

We may change the service or these terms and will change the date at the top. The operator’s name, a contact address and the governing law will be added here before launch.
